_comment: The tests CI's shards may report as skipped (scripts/ci_test_shards.py verify, #1151); any other skip, and a suite that runs no test, fails the shard report check, because an incomplete run is not a pass (CNF-2, docs/design-rules.md). Each entry names the module, suite and test as the JUnit report does, the environment variables whose absence skips it (`environment`) or the data it waits on (`data`), and the issue that owns running it. An entry whose test runs is refused: remove it with the change that makes the test run. Read from CI run 44935743836 (2026-11-21, main b9cb03153). Eleven of the #294 entries are the external-data cases of scripts/candidate_acceptance/cases.json, which the manual candidate-acceptance workflow runs with their data; the twelfth is the ignored multiScalarMul comparison, a follow-up in #294's checklist. #1293 moves the five FormatBenchSuite benchmarks to `tools` (TOOL-1).
